mission.goal: Provide a compliant one-click ChatBridge successor-chat handoff and the strongest lawful no-administrator deployment route for a managed Windows browser.
mission.workflow: Observe rendered chat, checkpoint, detect limit, open a route-preserving successor, inject a one-time capsule; separately inspect browser policy read-only and route a blocked install to an enterprise handoff.
mission.data: Rendered message roles/text, source URL/title, bounded session capsule, transcript-free local summary; readiness assessor reads browser executable paths, extension manifest and Edge/Chrome policy registry values only.
mission.interface: Chrome/Edge Manifest V3 content/background scripts plus a read-only Windows PowerShell readiness assessor.
mission.stack: Vanilla JavaScript, Chrome Extensions APIs, PowerShell 5-compatible Windows inspection and Node built-in tests.
mission.environment: chatgpt.com in Chromium browsers; Windows 11 target; local dependency-free validation.
mission.governance: Formation-gated, zero recurring cost, reversible, proof-state separated; no elevation or enterprise-policy bypass.
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid capsules, restrictive or indeterminate deployment state; preserve native fallback; no provider or installation claims without browser readback.
mission.testing: Static JavaScript syntax, deterministic unit/failure-first tests, no-elevation policy-contract regression, manifest and build-contract validation.
mission.deployment: Existing extension patched in place; target-browser installation or enterprise-managed deployment requires native readback.
mission.continuity: Canonical ChatBridge registry and adapter pointers plus project handoff files.

assumptions.stack: Manifest V3 is supported by current Chrome/Edge.
assumptions.runtime: Content scripts run on chatgpt.com; service worker can use storage and tabs.
assumptions.storage: Session storage for full capsules; local storage for transcript-free summaries.
assumptions.authentication: Existing signed-in ChatGPT browser session; extension uses no credentials.
assumptions.deployment: GitHub registration is separate from user-browser installation.

components.frontend: Injected accessible action, status chip, and options page.
components.backend: Manifest V3 service worker with validated messages and tab-bound transfer.
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: no database; Chrome storage is sufficient.
components.queue: Single pending transfer object with one-time consume semantics.
components.scheduler: MutationObserver plus debounced checkpoint timer; no background schedule.
components.cache: Session latest capsule and pending transfer.
components.authentication: NOT_APPLICABLE: no remote API; browser host permission only.

observability.health_checks: runtime settings and pending-transfer message responses
observability.structured_logs: bounded error responses and status chip
observability.audit_logs: local latest capsule summary without transcript

testing.unit: five bridge-core tests plus four no-admin readiness and enterprise-boundary tests
testing.integration: background/content contracts verified by syntax plus browser-canary checklist; PowerShell contract is statically safety-tested because no Windows runtime is attached
testing.e2e_or_smoke: live signed-in ChatGPT warning-to-successor canary pending target-browser trust boundary
testing.fixtures_mocks: deterministic warning strings, URLs, messages, thresholds, policy names and prohibited mutation primitives
testing.failure_first: invalid notice, bounded transcript, native fallback, invalid capsule, composer timeout, elevation attempt, registry mutation, policy bypass, wildcard allow and false deployment identity
commands: node --check src/bridge-core.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/content-script.js && node --check options/options.js && node --test tests/*.test.js

setup_commands: No dependency install and no administrator password required for the readiness assessor
run_commands: Readiness assessor is available for an authorized Windows runtime; target browser UI or enterprise deployment remains a separate trust boundary
deploy_commands: Use user-profile sideload only when effective browser policy allows it; otherwise use the reviewed enterprise handoff and exact-ID managed distribution
rollback_commands: Disable or remove extension; readiness assessor changes no system state
delivery.debugging: Inspect readiness JSON, edge://policy, extension service worker, content-script console, status chip and pending session transfer without claiming states not read back.

formation.authority_class: A2 scoped source registration and owner backup; browser deployment excluded

watchman.blocked_capability: Native OpenAI host-button modification and browser installation are unavailable through current machine authority.
watchman.safe_substitute: Reversible Manifest V3 companion with native fallback and isolated deployment package.
watchman.closure_test: Signed-in browser canary with exact DOM and successor-chat readback.

continuity.idempotency: capsuleId plus tab-bound one-time pending transfer
continuity.checkpoints: debounced session capsule and transcript-free local summary
continuity.resume_conditions: matching successor tab and unconsumed transfer
